Hi Ana — thanks for raising this. Short answer: VAT needs to be calculated on the prorated taxable base; the current VAT line looks like a system rounding bug when an add-on is activated mid-cycle. Apologies for the confusion.

What we'll do:
- Issue an amended invoice that applies VAT to the prorated storage charge (we'll include a small reconciliation line for the rounding delta).
- If QuanticX is using reverse-charge (EU B2B), please confirm your VAT ID and country and we will apply reverse-charge on the amended invoice instead of charging VAT.
- If you prefer not to wait for the amendment, we can issue a credit note and reissue; or we can provide a one-line adjustment on the next cycle.

I'll need quick confirmation of your VAT ID to decide between reissue vs. credit. Jordan — can you run the prorate calc and attach the draft amended invoice? Kimberly — can you confirm whether Finance can expedite a credit note today if needed? Monica — loop in collections for payment hold messaging.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Summary of calculations (for internal review and to include on the amended invoice):
- Storage add-on list price: EUR 5,000 / month (taxable)
- Activation date: 2026-11-11 (billing cycle 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30)
- Prorated days: 20/30 = 0.6667 => Prorated base = EUR 3,333.33
- VAT @ 20% on prorated base = EUR 666.67 (if charging VAT)
- Previously charged VAT line incorrectly showed EUR 1,000.00 (full-month VAT).
- Rounding reconciliation = EUR -333.33 (amount we need to credit back if VAT was overcharged).

Two options for QuanticX (please confirm):
A) Reverse-charge (preferred for EU B2B): we apply reverse-charge on amended invoice; net due = EUR 3,333.33, VAT = 0.00 (requires VAT ID and country).
B) Standard VAT charged and immediate credit note for the EUR 333.33 overcharge; net effect same, but requires credit processing.
